job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




Mandatory Skills -




Node.js,Python,Express.js / NestJS ,FastAPI, LLM Integration (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock),Agentic AI ,AI Workflow Orchestration, Prompt Engineering

Design, develop, and deploy scalable backend applications using Node.js, Python, and AWS.
Build and integrate AI-powered applications utilizing LLMs and Agentic AI frameworks.
Develop autonomous and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, workflow execution, and tool orchestration.
Design and implement cloud-native and serverless architectures on AWS.
Build APIs, orchestration services, and intelligent workflow engines to support AI-driven business processes.
Integrate enterprise applications, databases, SaaS platforms, and external APIs with AI agents.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions for enterprise knowledge management.
Optimize AI application performance, scalability, observability, security, and cost.
Develop CI/CD pipelines and automate deployments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Data Scientists, and AI Engineers to deliver AI-driven products.
